title: Harth

{{Infobox Character |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Harth Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Harth Model.png }} |caption= |title= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= Mr. Harth{{Cite|{{Small|I mean...I feel bad that Molli's dad, Mr. Harth, got hurt, but...}} But I definitely know I don't want to practice singing!|Genli|BotW}} |TotK= Master Harth{{Cite|Now that our investigation of the geoglyphs has concluded, we will turn our attention to helping elsewhere. However...since we cannot fly, we cannot help with {{Color TotK|Red|Master Harth}}'s investigation of the sky islands. I doubt that I, one who withdrew from the front lines long ago, can help with Lady Buliara's {{Color TotK|Red|weapon strengthening}} either. Perhaps I can be of some use to {{Color TotK|Red|Josha's investigation of the Depths}}... Hm. Though I may just end up being a hindrance due to my lack of resistance to {{Color TotK|Red|gloom}}...|Muzu|TotK}} }} |race= [[Rito]] |gender= Male{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 127}} |game= BotW, TotK |other= |era= [[Era of the Wilds]] |family= [[Molli]] {{Small|(daughter)}}{{Cite|My daughter, Molli, is around the same age as Teba's kid, Tulin, so our families spend a lot of time together.|Harth|BotW}} |voiceactor= |theme= |counter= }} {{Term/Store|Harth||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite|Harth|Game Screen|BotW}}{{Cite|Harth|Game Screen|TotK}} ==Biography== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Harth is a young [[Rito]] man who serves as [[Rito Village]]'s [[Bow]] craftsman.{{Cite|[You are?] I am Harth, the bow craftsman.|Harth|BotW}}{{Cite|I am Harth. Bow craft is my trade.|Harth|BotW}} He has been friends with [[Teba]] since they were children.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 400}}{{Cite|Teba. Him and I go way back.
As far as flying goes, he is undoubtedly the best in the village.|Harth|BotW}} When he was young, Harth dreamed of being a warrior, but he ended up inheriting his family's Bow-crafting business.{{Cite|My boyhood dream was to be a warrior, but I gave that up once it came time to inherit the family business.|Harth|BotW}} From this business, he learned how to recreate the [[Great Eagle Bow]]. Harth is the father of [[Molli]]. Prior to [[Link]]'s arrival in Rito Village, Harth refused to listen to [[Kaneli]] when he told them only a Champion could enter [[Divine Beast Vah Medoh]].{{Cite|Only a chosen one, a {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion}}, can stop a {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast}}. You must enter the beast and bend it to your will. I tried explaining this to the more headstrong Rito warriors, but they wouldn't listen to reason.|Kaneli|BotW}} He and Teba attempted to face the [[Divine Beast]] on their own, which resulted in Harth becoming injured.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Teba}} and {{Color BotW|Blue|Harth}} tried to confront {{Color BotW|Blue|Medoh}}, but it did not go well, and {{Color BotW|Blue|Harth}} was injured.|Kaneli|BotW}} Harth was forced to retreat because of this.{{Cite|Unfortunately, Harth was shot down by {{Color BotW|Blue|Medoh}} and had to retreat.|Kaneli|BotW}} Link can find him in his home, where he is in much pain.{{Cite|Owwwwwwwww...|Harth|BotW}} Though he initially welcomes Link,{{Cite|Arrgh... Welcome. Owwww...|Harth|BotW}} he dismisses him when he asks what is wrong with him.{{Cite|[What's the matter?] No offense, but this is not your concern.|Harth|BotW}} Afterwards, he curses Medoh.{{Cite|That cursed {{Color BotW|Blue|monster}}...|Harth|BotW}} If Link speaks to Harth again, he will still welcome him.{{Cite|Ugh...
Welcome...
Oww...|Harth|BotW}} When asked who he is, Harth introduces himself as the Bow craftsman. Due to his injury, however, he is unable to raise his arm, so his business has halted.{{Cite|But... I cannot raise my arm right now, so business is not exactly booming.|Harth|BotW}} Once again, Link can ask him if he is alright, but this time Harth admits that he is not.{{Cite|Are you all right?] Not really...|Harth|BotW}} He regrets not listening to Kaneli's warnings about the Divine Beast.{{Cite|If this is what we are up against, we should have put more stock in the {{Color BotW|Blue|elder}}'s words.|Harth|BotW}} After Link speaks to Kaneli, Harth decides to tell Link about what happened when he faced Divine Beast Vah Medoh.{{Cite|Hey, buddy... I'm guessing you caught wind of that {{Color BotW|Blue|monster}} circling around our village. I suppose I should get you up to speed on what went down.|Harth|BotW}}{{Note|If Link refuses to listen, Harth will call out that he still has more to say.{{Cite|[No, I'm fine.] ...Are you leaving? But I have more to say!|Harth|BotW}}}} Harth reveals that the wound on his wing came from Medoh,{{Cite|Here goes... You see this wound here on my wing? I got shot by {{Color BotW|Blue|that thing in the sky, Divine Beast Vah Medoh}}.|Harth|BotW}} which was supposedly once a protector of Rito Village.{{Cite|Legend has it, that monster was once the protector of this village.|Harth|BotW}} However, when he and Teba approached the Divine Beast, it unexpectedly shot at them.{{Cite|But those days are long gone—as soon as Teba and I approached the thing, it just shot at us out of nowhere.|Harth|BotW}} Though Harth tried to fight back, he was too slow and ended up being hit.{{Cite|We tried to fight back, but I was too slow and got hit.|Harth|BotW}} Teba managed to catch him before he fell out of the sky, and the pair ended up retreating.{{Cite|Thankfully, Teba caught me while I was falling from the sky. We had no choice but to retreat.|Harth|BotW}} Harth is frightened when he thinks of what would have happened had Teba not been there to save him.{{Cite|When I think about what would have happened had Teba not been there... Still gives me the bumps.|Harth|BotW}} Now that Link knows the story, Harth asks if he is going to find Teba and promises to tell him everything he knows.{{Cite|So you planning to go find Teba? I will tell you everything I know.|Harth|BotW}}{{Cite|Anything else you wanted to ask about?|Harth|BotW}} Link can then ask Harth about Divine Beast Vah Medoh, Teba, or himself. When Link asks about the Divine Beast, Harth shares the legend that it protected Rito Village before it disappeared 100 years ago, though he does not believe this to be true.{{Cite|[Who's Medoh?] Divine Beast Vah Medoh... I don't believe it myself, but some say it used to protect our village before disappearing 100 years ago.|Harth|BotW}} His injury occurred when he and Teba went to investigate it.{{Cite|Teba and I got to wondering about it, and when we went to investigate, it just opened fire on us...hence the injury.|Harth|BotW}} As soon as he is able, Harth plans on taking a lot of [[Bomb Arrow]]s up to it and destroying its [[Cannon]]s.{{Cite|But as soon as I recover, I plan to fly up there with a while mess of {{Color BotW|Blue|bomb arrows}} and {{Color BotW|Red|blow its cannons to bits}}!|Harth|BotW}} When Link asks about Teba, Harth explains that they have known each other for a while and that Teba is the best at flying in Rito Village. While Teba is reckless, temperamental, and rude, he and Harth look out for each other.{{Cite|His only downside is that he's reckless...and has a bit of a temper...and he can be rude. But we look out for each other.|Harth|BotW}} However, Harth was disturbed by the way Teba was speaking before he left.{{Cite|But the way he was talking...saying that he was going to "blow {{Color BotW|Blue|Medoh}} out of the sky."|Harth|BotW}} He is angered that Teba intends to face Divine Beast Vah Medoh alone, especially since he has a wife and a child.{{Cite|He wants to go back up there...alone. Which is absolutely insane. What kind of moron with a wife and a kid does that?|Harth|BotW}} If Link asks Harth who he is, he will explain his trade and his childhood dream. He also reveals that he is the father of Molli, and since she is close in age with [[Tulin]], his family spends a lot of time with Teba's. However, he stops his explanation when he realizes nothing he said was helpful to Link.{{Cite|Hold on... Is any of this helpful at all?|Harth|BotW}} After Divine Beast Vah Medoh has been calmed, Harth will begin to work on a [[Swallow Bow]]. Harth is willing to do Link the service of crafting him a new Great Eagle Bow, should he ever lose or break the one he receives from Kaneli.{{Cite|If you break or lose the {{Color BotW|Blue|Great Eagle Bow}}, I can make a new one for you.|Harth|BotW}} In this scenario, Harth will need a Swallow Bow, five bundles of [[Wood]], and a [[Diamond]] in order to craft a new one.{{Cite|But you will need to bring me a {{Color BotW|Blue|swallow bow}}, {{Color BotW|Red|five}} bundles of {{Color BotW|Blue|wood}}, and a {{Color BotW|Blue|diamond}}.|Harth|BotW}} As they are expensive to make, Harth suggests Link try to find the Bow if he has lost it somewhere.{{Cite|Where is your {{Color BotW|Blue|Great Eagle Bow}}? Did you drop it somewhere? I can make you another one, but they are expensive to make. Maybe you should try to find your old one first.|Harth|BotW}} When Link tries to take the Swallow Bow from the table near Harth, he will call him out.{{Cite|Hey...|Harth|BotW}} If Harth is still injured, he will tell Link to keep it, as he is unable to use it.{{Cite|Heh... Take it.
Not like I can use it in my condition.|Harth|BotW}} After freeing Divine Beast Vah Medoh, however, Harth allows Link to keep it as a reward.{{Cite|Sure, go ahead an take it.
Consider it thanks for conquering {{Color BotW|Blue|Medoh}}.|Harth|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Harth Concept Artwork.png|Concept artwork of Harth from {{CaC|-}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Molli * Rito * Rito Village }} {{Notes}} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Hyruleans, Rito, Rito Villagers |characters= BotW, TotK }}
